# ReplaceObjectType: no additional properties make a fixed class, no
# properties a map, `any` additional properties a class (losing them), and
# both a map of the union of all property types.
builder prov
prim i integer
str s unrestricted
prim any any
prim b bool
obj closed a:i,b?:s - n=Closed
obj open {} s n=Open
obj loose a:i any n=Loose
obj full a:i,b:s b n=Full
obj full2 a:i,b:s b n=Full2
arr arr full
cls top c:closed,o:open,l:loose,f:full,f2:full2,arr:arr n=Top
top Top top
finish printonrewrite
replaceobj debug
gc
print

# Languages with full object types keep objects with both.
builder prov
prim i integer
str s unrestricted
obj closed a:i - n=Closed
obj full a:i s n=Full
cls top c:closed,f:full n=Top
top Top top
finish
replaceobj full debug
print
replaceobj full
